meta.name: analytical-method-validation
meta.description: Plan, execute, and document validation, verification, and transfer of analytical procedures under the governing framework - ICH Q2(R2) and Q14, USP <1220>/<1225>/<1226>, ICH M10 bioanalytical, CLSI EP, or ISO/IEC 17025. Use for HPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC, CE, ICP-MS, dissolution, qNMR, qPCR, NIR, and ligand binding or cell-based assays whenever the question is whether a procedure is fit for its intended purpose. Triggers include "method validation", "analytical method validation", "AMV", "validation protocol", "acceptance criteria", "linearity", "reportable range", "accuracy and precision", "repeatability", "intermediate precision", "recovery", "LOD", "LOQ", "detection limit", "quantitation limit", "specificity", "robustness", "method transfer", "method comparison", "Deming", "Passing-Bablok", "Bland-Altman", "equivalence testing", "OOS investigation", "ICH Q2", "Q2(R2)", "Q14", "USP 1225", "ICH M10", "incurred sample reanalysis", "ISR", "CLSI EP", and any request to show that an assay works.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把关分析检测方法是否经得起验证审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要给实验室检测方法准备验证和证明材料。
copy.tagline_en: Prove your lab method is reliable for its intended use before release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must show an analytical method is fit for its intended purpose under regulations.

howto.what: 装上后它会规划并记录分析方法验证、确认与转移:先定法规框架,再生成方案骨架,计算线性、准确度与精密度、检出/定量限、生物分析批次和两法等效性统计。脚本只报告,不替你放行或判定。
howto.when: 当你要判断某个分析方法是否适用于其预期用途时触发:设计验证研究、评估验证数据、转移方法到另一实验室等,涵盖 HPLC、LC-MS/MS 等;提 "method validation"、"AMV" 也触发。

say.text: 用 ICH Q2(R2) 给 HPLC 含量测定生成一份验证方案骨架。
say.note: 验收标准会留空,需你采数前自己填。

say.text: 检查这份校准曲线数据的线性,回算误差上限设 2%。
say.note: 会给出失拟检验和残差模式,不只报 r²。

say.text: 两种方法的数据在这里,按 2% 边距做等效性检验(TOST)。
say.note: 会给出 90% 置信区间和是否等效的判断。

howto.what_en: Claude plans and documents analytical method validation, verification and transfer: framework and protocol skeleton first, then linearity, accuracy/precision, DL/QL, bioanalytical run checks and equivalence. Scripts report only.
howto.when_en: Use when asking whether an analytical procedure is fit for its purpose: designing or evaluating validation data, verifying a compendial procedure, or transferring a method to another lab.

say_en.text: Draft an ICH Q2(R2) validation protocol skeleton for an HPLC assay.
say_en.note: Acceptance criteria stay blank; you fill them before data.

say_en.text: Check the linearity of this calibration data; max back-calculated error 2%.
say_en.note: Gives lack-of-fit and residual pattern, not just r2.

say_en.text: Run a TOST equivalence test on these two methods at a 2% margin.
say_en.note: Reports the 90% CI and whether methods are equivalent.
